A [[Zelosian]] '''security guard''' was on duty at a [[Unidentified spaceport (Zelos II)|spaceport]] on [[Zelos II]] when an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[T'Charek Haathi's Special Ops team|Special Ops team]] stole [[The Maker (YT-1300 light freighter)|''The Maker'']]. He almost killed [[Morgan Q. Raventhorn]], but was in turn incapacitated by a neuro-shock field.
